diagnostics.message: `:resource.local_file.public_ssh_key` has an explicit `depends_on` on `:resource.tls_private_key.ssh`, but its `content` attribute already references `tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh`, so Terraform already infers this dependency implicitly. The explicit `depends_on` is redundant.

`:resource.local_file.private_ssh_key` has an explicit `depends_on` on `:resource.tls_private_key.ssh`, but its `content` attribute already references `tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem`, so Terraform already infers this dependency implicitly. The explicit `depends_on` is redundant.

`module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` launches the runner instance whose user-data configures CloudWatch logging into `module.runner:resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.environment`, but the ASG has no dependency on that log group. Terraform may launch the instance before the log group exists, causing logging setup to fail.
